variant.title: Self-Referential Frequency Operator Fixture
variant.description: A technical reference for an exact self-referential digit-frequency group.
rule_guide.title: Frequency Reference Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: In the marked group, every digit that appears must occur exactly that many times.
rule_guide.item_3: The cell containing a digit is included when counting its occurrences.
